item.title: Federal judge approves 12% rate increase for Jackson water bills
item.description: The average Jackson water customer will soon have to pay close to an additional $10 each month for services. U.S. District Judge Henry Wingate approved on Monday a 12% rate hike recommended by JXN Water, the third-party utility manager overseeing the city’s water services. item.description: A Starkville police officer is in “critical condition” after being involved in a collision while assisting with a funeral procession escort. Local law enforcement officials reported that the incident occurred Saturday afternoon, involving an unidentified officer on a motorcycle and a vehicle that was not part of the procession. item.title: T&L Extra: Coach Brian O’Connor Joins SportsTalk Mississippi
item.description: Mississippi State stayed among the ranks of the unbeaten, and remained #4 in the nation after a 5-0 week. Brian Hadad speaks with Coach Brian O’Connor following his team’s sweep clinching win over Delaware.

item.title: Thunder & Lightning: Is Tuesday The Final Dress Rehearsal For Mississippi State Baseball?
item.description: Mississippi State isn’t overlooking Austin Peay, but with a massive weekend ahead for the Diamond Dawgs, is Tuesday’s game the last chance for Coach Brian O’Connor to figure out his lineup and rotation? Brian Hadad and Robbie Faulk discuss that, plus hear from the Diamond Dawg skipper following Sunday’s game.

item.description: A cyberattack last week is continuing to impact operations at the University of Mississippi Medical Center.
